item.title: Verbose beta 297
item.description:
Names on calls, stills you can open, and new sounds

Mac

  • A call tied to a calendar event suggests the other person's name instead of the app's. Verbose uses the invite, or a title like "Dana x Priya", and listens for those names and the title's words. Names it hears wrong, like "Thanks, Sam", are fixed from the invite and shown in Review.
  • Talking over each other no longer splits sentences or leaves one-word lines. Short replies like "yeah" wait for the other person's sentence to end, and a cut-off sentence joins back together.
  • Verbose has its own soft sounds for starting, stopping, pasting, finishing, and errors. Frequent moments get a quiet tick and rare ones a short chime. Your microphone doesn't record them. Settings › Sounds on the Mac and Settings › Haptics on the iPhone turn them off.
  • Click or tap a still beside a transcript to open it large, zoom, and step through them. On the Mac, copy the image or select its text. On the iPhone, swipe between stills and share one. Play from here starts the recording at that moment.
  • Going to Library, You, or any page slides it in smoothly instead of jumping partway. The page is in place from the first frame, and its slight bounce starts once it's drawn, so a page that takes a moment to build no longer skips the start.
  • On Home, the Journal card's weekday letters and play length are no longer cut off.
